project_metadata.target_audience: ESG Managers, Sustainability Officers, Supplier Compliance Auditors
project_metadata.core_task: Align module page headings across BRSR Framework, Materiality Assessment, GHG, and Core ESG modules with Supplier Assessment standard page headers

key_functionalities: Reusable module page header component (ModulePageHeader / SupplierPageHeader)
Color-coded leading icon with rounded border and subtle shadow
Title-only heading alignment (no extra optional short context lines)
Consistent layout across BRSR Framework, Materiality Assessment, GHG, and core ESG pages

header_specification.container_class: flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-stone-200 pb-5 mb-6

icon_badge.style: flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border shadow-sm

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor module headers across BRSR Framework, Materiality Assessment, GHG Emissions, and other core ESG pages to utilize the standardized header format modeled after SupplierPageHeader.
Ensure each module header renders a color-coded left icon badge (h-12 w-12 rounded-lg border shadow-sm) matching the module domain.
Omit short context lines / sub-description paragraphs underneath titles where title-only alignment is specified.
Ensure all header elements include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='{module}-heading', data-testid='{module}-heading-icon').
Maintain responsive mobile-first behavior and preserve right-aligned action buttons/status badges inside the header layout.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds on surfaces that have content underneath.
Always specify text colors explicitly on hover states to guarantee APCA/WCAG contrast.
Ensure direct parent-child hierarchy in grid layouts.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, headers, and key informational elements.
Avoid AI slop, centered text body layouts, and Space Grotesk font family.
